title: Payment step 4 — COMPLETED, and the residue returned
description: Forty-one seconds end to end. 1,000 CLP delivered to Banco de Valparaiso, 542.75 CRC consumed, and the 5.43 CRC slippage buffer that had to be bridged in is back with the payer.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway, spoke-crc. DO NOT STOP AT status == COMPLETED. residue_status is what makes an over-debit visible: RETURNED means the payer was made whole, RETURN_FAILED means the buffer is still stranded on the Hub swap signer and the payer is short — see mocks/amm/residue. The arithmetic reconciles exactly: max_amount_in 548181340558471952655 minus amount_in 542753802533140547183 equals residue_amount 5427538025331405472.
